method.description: Direct structural measurement of the HCJDC 159(b) binary. The retained repository copy was located, hashed and measured; the issuer's currently published binary was retrieved once to a scratch path and hashed; the two were compared. Structure was measured with poppler-utils (pdfinfo, pdfinfo -box, pdffonts, pdfimages, pdftotext, pdftotext -bbox) and independently with pdf-lib reading the catalog, page dictionary and annotation arrays directly. Nothing was inferred from the absence of an AcroForm.
measurementTools: poppler-utils pdfinfo (document dictionary, page size, rotation, encryption, AcroForm presence, PDF version)
poppler-utils pdfinfo -box (per-page MediaBox, CropBox, BleedBox, TrimBox, ArtBox as resolved after spec defaulting)
poppler-utils pdffonts (font inventory and embedding state)
poppler-utils pdftotext and pdftotext -bbox (text layer and per-word geometry)
pdf-lib PDFDocument.load reading catalog /AcroForm, page /Annots, /Rotate and every page box directly
method.zeroValuesAreMeasuredNotAssumed: Each zero recorded below is the result of a measurement. Zero widget annotations was established by reading the page dictionary and finding no /Annots array at all, not by observing that pdfinfo reports Form: none. Zero raster images was established by an empty pdfimages -list. Absent page boxes are recorded as absent-and-defaulting, not as zero.

technicalStructure.mimeTypeBasis: Declared as application/pdf by the issuer's Content-Type header and independently confirmed by file-magic identification as a PDF document, version 1.6.

technicalStructure.xfaBasis: The document catalog has no /AcroForm entry at all, so there is no /AcroForm /XFA key. XFA absence here follows from the absence of the containing dictionary, not from an unread key.
technicalStructure.logicalFieldsBasis: No /AcroForm in the document catalog, therefore no /Fields array and no logical field hierarchy.
technicalStructure.terminalFieldsBasis: pdf-lib getForm().getFields() returned an empty array.
technicalStructure.widgetAnnotationsBasis: Measured, not inferred. Page 1's page dictionary carries no /Annots array whatsoever, so the total annotation count of every subtype is 0 and the widget subtype count is therefore 0. A flat PDF can carry orphan widget annotations that no AcroForm references; this one carries none.
technicalStructure.structuralClassDetail: Zero logical fields, zero terminal fields and zero widget annotations, confirmed by two independent readers. There is no field map to build for this document and no acroform_fill implementation is possible against it.

fonts.overlayConsequence: Every font is an embedded subset. An overlay renderer cannot reuse a subset font resource to add new characters, because a subset carries only the glyphs the original document already prints. Overlay text must therefore be drawn with a font the renderer embeds itself. The Wingdings and SymbolMT subsets are the bullet and checkbox glyphs of the printed face, not interactive controls.

imageInventory.basis: pdfimages -list returned an empty inventory: no XObject images on any page.
imageInventory.consequence: The document is entirely text and vector content. There is no scanned layer.

textStructure.textLayerReliabilityBasis: The file is a tagged PDF generated by Acrobat PDFMaker 26 for Word from a word-processor original, carries zero raster images, and every one of its nine fonts is embedded with a ToUnicode map. Extraction produced 6,580 characters and 851 positioned words with no substitution artefacts, no missing-glyph markers and no reading-order breakage. Text extraction is a sound basis for locating printed labels; it is not itself a fill mechanism.
textStructure.textLayerReliabilityCaveat: Reliability of the text layer is a statement about reading the document, not about writing to it. It does not make the document fillable, and it does not substitute for the geometry an overlay must be keyed on.

overlayCoordinateBasis.basisStatement: Single page, /Rotate 0, MediaBox origin at (0, 0) coincident with the CropBox origin, MediaBox equal to CropBox. PDF user space is therefore identical to page space with no translation, no rotation and no scaling transform: a point at user-space (x, y) is at (x, y) on the printed page, measured from the bottom-left corner in points, over the range x in [0, 612] and y in [0, 792].
overlayCoordinateBasis.conversionNote: pdftotext -bbox reports coordinates in a top-left, y-down frame. Converting to PDF user space on this document is y_user = 792 - y_topLeft, with x unchanged, because the MediaBox origin is (0, 0) and the page height is exactly 792. Any later overlay work that mixes the two frames without this conversion will place content upside down about the page's horizontal midline.
risks: The single-page, unrotated, origin-at-zero geometry means an overlay needs no normalizing transform. That is the best case and it is what makes a coordinate overlay tractable here.
Every font is an embedded subset, so overlay text requires the renderer to embed its own font.

Coordinates are pinned to sha256 1cb4f3acc20d569820379410c3aeb67c59fe3e24866932696371f25efaad935a. A future revision reflows the page and invalidates every anchor; the geometry must be re-measured against any new digest before it is reused.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest accurate result. It is not unresolved_identity: identity, title, issuer, role, scope, revision, bytes and every structural attribute are established, and the identity was independently reconfirmed against the live issuer publication today. It is not exact_identity_confirmed_source_materialized: no receipt exists, no asset is in the materialized source root, and this job is forbidden to create either. It is not edition_amendment_complete: the successor edition is unpublished and the asset row specified here is a handoff, not an adoption. What the record needed was the measurement the identity decision was barred from taking, and a complete asset specification for the successor edition; both are now supplied and what remains is an edition act and a captain act.
